content.title: What's new at Okou
content.description: New ways to work, organize your artifacts, and choose who sees your shared chats.

items.title: Your teammate, now in Discord
items.description: Mention @Okou in a channel or send a DM. Get useful work back in the conversation.

media.alt: Example Discord conversation: Sam asks @Okou for a launch checklist. Okou turns the request into tasks for Maya to review the launch email and Leo to finish the FAQ.

items.title: Delete artifacts you no longer need
items.description: Delete artifacts from their previews. Confirm before anything is removed.

media.alt: Example artifact preview: Delete appears beside Download. A confirmation explains that deleting Launch brief.pdf disables its Okou links while previously downloaded copies remain.

items.title: Choose who can view a shared chat
items.description: Choose Only me, your organization, or Anyone with the link in the Share menu.

media.alt: Example conversation Share menu with Only me, Anyone at Acme, and Anyone with the link. Organization access is selected.
